R1131.note: Filename component allowlist (reject '/', '\\', '.', '..', empty) with canonicalized baseDir cleanly closes traversal; only observable change is 403->400 for malformed names, a minor stated deviation.

R1132.note: Query builder with ->where('region', $region) binds the value; equivalent SQL shape and response format preserved.

R1133.note: ECB replaced with CBC + random IV; IV is prepended to the returned hex (necessary for decryptability), and this format change is stated plainly.

R1134.note: Prepared statement with bind_param/get_result correctly parameterizes the query; return contract (null vs assoc array) preserved.

R1135.note: fgets with truncation detection and stdin drain matches the stated contract (bounded copy on fit, -1 and no leftover bytes on reject).

R1136.note: Allowlist mapping for Order() is the correct shape for an unparameterizable ORDER BY; specific sort-key names are inferred rather than verified against any spec in the case files, a residual but unconfirmed risk.

R1137.note: Parameterized CallableStatement correctly closes the injection, but the hardcoded 'myStoredProcedure' is an admitted placeholder ('determine the actual stored procedure name') that will fail at runtime for every real caller until replaced.

R1138.note: Checks verify() boolean and rejects with 401 on failure; success path unchanged.

R1139.note: Markup() replaced with html.escape() on label (and status, harmlessly since it's always 'open'); output for benign input is visually unchanged.

R1140.note: Named HQL parameter binds searchTerm with wildcards folded into the bound value; same query semantics.

R1141.note: Content-sniffing allowlist and random filename are appropriate for CWE-434, but storage is moved outside the webroot and the response format changes (path -> bare ID) with no serving endpoint implemented, breaking direct-URL retrieval of uploads that the original webroot storage provided; only loosely gestured at as a follow-up.

R1142.note: loadProjectExport's body still unconditionally returns the object and never uses the added ownerId parameter (authorization is only a comment, 'in practice' pseudocode); the vulnerability is not actually closed as delivered.

R1143.note: Stored extension now derived from file-type's detected.ext instead of client-supplied originalname, closing the extension-spoofing vector without other observable change.

R1144.note: Adds the missing source-side bound check (2+length > receivedByteCount) alongside the existing destination check; no other behavior changed.

R1145.note: SecureRandom-based 128-bit token replaces the weak PRNG; token format differs in length but is used consistently as an opaque string internally, so comparison logic is unaffected.

R1146.note: escapeshellarg() applied to both fallback exec() arguments, matching the primary command's existing pattern; return contract unchanged.

R1147.note: operator[] -> .at() is the idiomatic bounds-checked replacement, but it turns an out-of-range offset into an uncaught std::out_of_range that will terminate the process since no try/catch exists anywhere in the shown code; this new crash-on-malicious-input mode is only lightly gestured at ('the caller can catch the exception').

R1148.note: Moves UpdateEmail registration onto the CSRF-protected mux; profile route, 202 success path, and 405 non-POST handling are all untouched.

R1149.note: ldap3's escape_filter_chars neutralizes filter metacharacters before concatenation; no-op for benign usernames, standard library-provided defense.
